segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹבֵר אֶת הָעֶצֶם בַּפֶּסַח הַטָּהוֹר — הֲרֵי זֶה לוֹקֶה אַרְבָּעִים. אֲבָל הַמּוֹתִיר בַּטָּהוֹר וְהַשּׁוֹבֵר בְּטָמֵא — אֵינוֹ לוֹקֶה אֶת הָאַרְבָּעִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who breaks the bone of a Paschal lamb that is ritually pure receives forty lashes» for having violated a prohibition stated in the Torah. «But one who leaves over» part «of a ritually pure» Paschal lamb «and one who breaks» the bone «of a ritually impure» Paschal lamb «do not receive forty lashes.»

moves.summary: Breaking a bone of a pure Paschal lamb incurs lashes; leaving over or an impure lamb does not

positions.claim: breaking a bone of a pure Paschal lamb incurs forty lashes; leaving over a pure one or breaking a bone of an impure one does not
